Chapter 6543: Hiding

Chapter 6543: Hiding

Regardless of his ascension method, Bao Pu was still an immortal. Although eating a corpse was evil or at least disgusting, he still stood above supreme overlords and everyone else.

After all, the entry to the immortal realm was unimaginably high. Overlords who had reigned for epochs still risked their lives for this goal.

Moreover, could another cultivator replicate the process? This might not work for overlords.

Bao Pu certainly became an immortal due to the feast but this was just a shortcut, one of the countless requirements.

“You’re still the first progenitor, this is harming your reputation.” Black said.

This harkened the old days for the ancient progenitors. Rumor has it Bao Pu was the first of their line. They followed Bao Pu’s path for eras.

Of course, this couldn’t compare to Desolate Ancestor’s cultivation system but the world had benefited from Bao Pu’s insightful achievements.

He was still an immortal now, a supreme existence looming above everyone. Such a being shouldn’t be hiding his face. Would he care about the opinions of ants?

No one could see through the fiery veil, not even Black. Using a heavenly gaze might result in backlash and death.

“Are you ashamed of what you have done to your masters?” Black provoked.

However, the fiery figure focused on the blade alone - the only true threat to him.

Those qualified to watch became frustrated, wondering why Bao Pu wouldn’t show himself.

“Clank!” Calamitous Edge floated into the air since Desolate Ancestor wanted to end this.

This scared the hell out of everyone despite them being aware of her actual target.

“This is the hour. It’s a shame that we can’t see your face.” Black saw the blade moving and ordered: “Let’s go.”

He then flew away with the cauldron containing Nine Secrets. Skyfire Phoenix, the legion, and the staunch supporters withdrew as well, leaving behind Desolate Ancestor and Bao Pu.

“Clank!” Calamitous Edge sliced time and space, removing Corpse Wasteland from Heaven World.

Regular cultivators could no longer see it, only primal ancestors and above. The new battlefield was meant for immortals alone. Even supreme overlords couldn’t see all the details.

“Once before.” The fiery immortal finally uttered an ancient language. Perhaps only immortals could understand.

“Boom!” A cosmic egg was split open in this moment as if it were the start of the world. Was it the power of the high heaven or a supreme will?

Three Immortals, albeit immensely far away, still shook violently from the primordial shockwaves emanating from the explosion.

They understood the fight had begun. World barriers of the immortal level defended their world from being destroyed.

Darkness took over so no one knew which techniques were used during the fight. Only characters such as Black and Xian Chengtian could see a thing or two.
